blind.B1: Yes. Human vastus lateralis RNA-seq, 8 sedentary men before and after 6 weeks of supervised endurance training (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1). Every biopsy carries the exercise factor (Untrained/Trained = pre/post); there is no non-exercising control arm. GSE144133 is the RNA-seq sub-series of the SuperSeries GSE144134 named in S4.1.p1.
blind.B2: One comparison: trained (post) vs untrained (pre), n = 8 participants (FIG1 C, S3.1.p2). 16 biopsies in GEO; P6_2 and P8_2 excluded from DE for dermis-gene expression (S2.4.p1), leaving 8 pre and 6 post.
blind.B3: Yes. Each participant is sampled twice (pre and post). Identifier: characteristics_ch1.1.participant (P1-P8), also the title prefix; keys 8, links 16/16, once per training level, no duplicates.
blind.B4: One joint model on all samples: likelihood ratio test ~participant vs ~participant + training (S2.4.p1). Quote: 'comparing a model containing only participant information (~participant) to a model with participant and training status information (~participant + training)'.
blind.B5: FDR < 0.1 (Fig 1C legend; S3.1.p2: 'false discovery rate (FDR) < 0.1'), no fold-change cutoff; 13,108 genes tested, 641 up and 176 down (817). Methods S2.4.p1 call the q-values 'Bonferroni corrected', which conflicts with the FDR wording. Fold changes from a Wald test.

checks.evidence: Run decision matches B1: pre/post endurance training in 8 men (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1); the no-control-arm caveat is recorded in study.caveats.

alignment: train pre 8, post 6; P6_2 (GSM4281963) and P8_2 (GSM4281967) excluded by name with the paper's reason (S2.4.p1). Control is pre; the title suffix _1/_2 agrees with the Untrained/Trained field for every sample.
design: control pre, treatment post; contrast train_post_vs_pre. Paper reports trained vs untrained (S3.1.p2); mostly up-regulated in both.

covariance: subject (participant) is a blocking term, formula ~ subject + train, categorical, full rank, residual df 5. Same as the paper's ~participant. A sensitivity run on the 6 complete pairs is also reported.
Joint fit on all samples as in S2.4.p1; the sleuth LRT is replaced by limma moderated t with the same terms, declared as a deviation (bootstraps not deposited).
Single sex; pre/post time and any training-unrelated change (and waist-to-hip fat loss, S4.p5) cannot be separated without a control arm; recorded as a caveat in study.caveats.

matrix: GEO says 'estimated abundances'; 1.3% integer values, sub-Poisson variance, size factors 0.93-1.17 argue against counts; limma on log2(x+0.5) fits the sleuth log(x+0.5) model. p histogram is not piled up (frac_p_gt_0.9 = 0.082, frac_p_lt_0.05 = 0.111).

Rule transcribed correctly: padj < 0.1, no FC cutoff, non-inclusive (S3.1.p2, FIG1 C); the Bonferroni vs FDR wording is recorded. But packet B flags that pvalue<0.05 & |lfc|>0.585 gives 811 genes, close to the paper's 817, and the case does not record this as a possible alternative rule (padj<0.1 gives 16, raw p<0.05 alone 1431).
checks.fix: Optionally add a discrepancy entry noting that the paper's 817 fits raw p<0.05 with |log2FC|>0.585 (811) on the deposited abundances, while the stated rule is FDR < 0.1; this is the open policy question, so no change to the applied rule.

checks.evidence: Same contrast (post vs pre) and stated rule compared: ours 16 vs paper 817; HANDBACK attributes the gap to power and the method change and does not claim agreement in counts, only direction and GSEA themes.
No stop or refusal; the sleuth route is marked blocked because abundance.h5 bootstraps are not deposited, which is a true and sufficient reason, and the case ran a declared deviation.

human_items: Open policy question: the paper's 817 DEGs are matched by raw p < 0.05 with |log2FC| > 0.585 (811) rather than the stated FDR < 0.1 (16); which rule to report is not settled.
summary: 该案例设计正确：8名受试者训练前后配对，分组、排除样本（P6_2、P8_2）和参与者区组项均与论文一致，方向为post对pre。矩阵被正确识别为归一化丰度并用limma替代sleuth，已声明为偏离。唯一的小问题是阈值：论文的817个基因接近原始p<0.05且|log2FC|>0.585的811个，案例未记录这一点，属于待人工决定的开放问题。
